The altar is a complex structure with a white marble or stone base, draped with a white cloth, and topped with candles and floral arrangements. Behind the main table stands a large, elaborate altarpiece (reredos) with gold accents, columns, and religious iconography, set against a curved apse wall. Two tall, narrow windows flank the altar, letting in bright light.
